verdict.rationale: Speechmatics publishes comparison pages that set its accuracy and word error rate against Deepgram, Whisper and gpt-4o-transcribe, so there are published WER-based accuracy claims. Nothing in the evidence shows the benchmark datasets, test conditions or methodology behind those numbers, so it is unclear whether a founder could check them. missing for 10: documented benchmark methodology, named or downloadable benchmark datasets, reproducible evaluation details, independent corroboration of the published WER figures.

support.subject: As a founder, published accuracy claims come with a methodology or benchmark dataset I can check, not bare marketing numbers
